automated_assurance.workflow: OVC tiered test selection / profile / merge-readiness

observations: The central chart is materially more visually active than the merged WP3E baseline while the surrounding reference-locked shell geometry remains unchanged.
Bullish and bearish candles have stronger body, border and wick contrast against the dark chart surface.
The outer presentation envelope now follows exact source-bar high/low coordinates and visibly wraps the candle path rather than drifting in an independently normalized SVG coordinate space.
An inner body ribbon and restrained close-flow/high/mid/low traces add depth without introducing a market indicator, signal, probability, forecast or semantic claim.
The range navigator is visually richer while remaining source-derived and presentation-only.
Reference, responsive and adverse-state screenshots preserve fixture authority labels, null/residual states, inactive C2E and no horizontal overflow.

warnings: Visual acceptance remains reserved to RCN-G3V operator review; RCN-G3F QA PASS does not itself accept the visual baseline or authorize WP4.
The chart dynamics are presentation treatment over deterministic synthetic fixture OHLC and must not be interpreted as a scientific coverage model or market signal.
rollback: Revert WP3F-only FixtureChart, chart-dynamics stylesheet, import and assurance changes; retain merged WP3E reference-locked fixture capability.
